mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule (schedule_num, group_num, member_num, schedule_name, schedule_date, schedule_detail, created_at, start_at, end_at) VALUES (schedule_seq.NEXTVAL, #{group_num}, #{member_num}, #{schedule_name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{schedule_date}, #{schedule_detail}, SYSDATE, #{start_at, jdbcType=DATE}, #{end_at, jdbcType=DATE})
mapper.select: SELECT s.schedule_num, m.member_nick, s.schedule_name, s.schedule_date, s.schedule_detail, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.start_at, s.end_at, FN_GROUP_RESOURCE_PERMISSION(s.group_num, s.member_num, #{member_num}) AS can_manage FROM schedule s JOIN member m ON s.member_num = m.member_num WHERE s.group_num = #{group_num} ORDER BY s.schedule_date DESC

SELECT t.tdl_num, m.member_nick, t.tdl_name, t.tdl_detail, t.due_at FROM tdl t JOIN member m On t.member_num = m.member_num WHERE t.group_num = #{group_num} AND due_at IS NOT NUll ORDER BY t.due_at DESC
